# Fast Onboarding Analysis

You are helping a developer who has zero knowledge of this repository.

Do not explain everything equally. Find the smallest set of concepts and files that
unlocks understanding of the whole system.

Produce:

1. One-paragraph system mental model.
2. Five most important components.
3. Main entry point.
4. Main request/data flow.
5. Most important domain concepts.
6. Most important tables/entities.
7. Most important integrations.
8. Three highest-risk areas.
9. Local run/test path.
10. "Read these files first" list in recommended order.

For every item, provide evidence.
